name: A-buffer visibility sort for non-convex grids
aliases: Topological Sort with A-Buffer for Non-Convex Grids
definition: An algorithm to sort exterior faces for volume rendering on general non-convex grids using an A-buffer to manage pixel-level intersection lists, avoiding true visibility sort complexities while ensuring correct hardware rendering.
summary: A-buffer visibility sort for non-convex grids resolves occlusion gaps in non-convex grids using rasterization to determine segment ordering, avoiding expensive pairwise geometric tests.
